title: Policy Interpretation
description: Schema for Policy Interpreter agent output - M300-aligned analysis of project

project_name.description: Name of the project being analyzed

m300_alignment_score.description: Overall alignment score with M300 debt-sensitive principles (0-100)

alignment_narrative.description: 2-3 paragraph explanation of how project aligns with M300 goals and debt-sensitivity principles

grant_suitable_elements.description: Features that make this project attractive for grant funding

debt_exposure_risks.description: Any aspects that could create debt obligations or fiscal strain
examples: If loan component introduced, cooperative would bear debt

private_capital_risks.description: Risks if private capital is involved (capital flight, guarantees, etc.)
examples: Risk if developer model is imposed: could require tariff guarantees
Mitigation: Ensure cooperative retains asset ownership

community_ownership_justification.description: Explanation of why public/community ownership makes sense for this project

assumptions_list.description: Things that need verification before proceeding

recommended_framing.description: Suggested way to position the project for funders

debt_sensitivity_tier.description: Assessed debt sensitivity tier based on project structure
